title: Future modals i Future time clauses
summary: Pewność i możliwość w przyszłości (will, might, may, could) oraz czasy po when, as soon as, until.

sections.title: Future modals – jak bardzo jesteśmy pewni
sections.text:
- **will / won't** – jestem pewny: *It will be cold tomorrow.*
- **will probably / definitely** – bardzo prawdopodobne: *She'll probably come.*
- **might / may / could** – możliwe: *We might go to the seaside.*
- **might not / may not** – możliwe, że nie: *He might not have time.*

Uwaga na szyk: *will probably* / *probably won't*.

sections.title: Future time clauses
sections.text:
Po spójnikach czasu **when, as soon as, before, after, until, once** oraz po **if** mówiąc o przyszłości używamy **Present Simple**, a nie *will*.
- *I'll call you **when** I **arrive**.* (nie: when I will arrive)
- *We won't start **until** everyone **is** here.*
- *As soon as the truck **comes**, we'll unload it.*

examples.text: Before you leave, check the documents.

questions.q: I'll phone you as soon as I ___ home.
questions.why: Po as soon as → Present Simple.

questions.q: We won't leave until the rain ___.
When she ___ 18, she'll get a driving licence.
I'm not sure, but I ___ go to the party.

wrong: He probably will not to come.

questions.q: After I ___ school, I want to work in logistics.

questions.correct: I'll tell him when I see him.
wrong: I'll tell him when I will see him.
I tell him when I will see him.
I'll tell him when I'll see him.
questions.why: Po when → Present Simple, will tylko w zdaniu głównym.
